chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch.388: Han Li Flees From Core Formation Hunter – Who Will Survive?
chapter_meta_description: Wu Chou claims the Koi Infant Beast for Extreme Yin Island. A secret token triggers a massacre pact. Han Li reads the danger and runs, pursued by a Core Formation elder.
og_title: The Token That Dooms Witnesses – Han Li Runs for His Life
og_description: When Elders Miao and Gu reveal a secret identity to Wu Chou, anyone nearby becomes a liability. Diviner Qing flees first; Han Li is right behind him.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.388 – Han Li’s Escape Instinct
twitter_description: A Core Formation hunt begins. Han Li knows that in the Chaotic Star Sea, the only wrong move is to stay and watch.

lore_anchors.definition: A dense black mist produced by the Demonic Yin Art, corrosive to flesh and spiritual defenses.
The dreaded Nascent Soul overlord of Extreme Yin Island, said to have just completed a supreme demonic art after centuries of seclusion.
An ancient-grade treasure borrowed by the Six Serenity Hall; using it heavily drains the user’s energy.
A major force in the Chaotic Star Sea, currently on an expedition for the Koi Infant Beast’s demon core.
A grade-6 aquatic demon beast whose carcass yields a valuable demon core and rare body parts.
A speed-focused flying artifact Han Li acquired; extremely fast but has no defensive or passenger capacity.
A sinister demonic technique once practiced by the Yue Emperor and Qu Hun; Han Li finds its qi similar to the Demonic Yin Art.
